ngaap.guidance: 2024 guidance (25-Apr-2024; current / prior): Revenue $20.8B - $21.3B (prior $20.7B - $21.3B); adjusted segment operating margin > 15% (prior ~15%); Non-GAAP EPS $12.70 - $13.05 (prior $12.40 - $12.80); adjusted free cash flow ~$2.2B (~$2.2B). Segments: SAS revenue ~$7,000M (prior $6,900 - $7,100), operating margin ~12% (prior mid-high 11%); IMS revenue $6,400 - $6,600M (unchanged), margin low-mid 11% (unchanged); CS revenue $5,300 - $5,400M (unchanged), margin low-mid 24% (unchanged); AR revenue $2,400 - $2,500M (unchanged), margin high 11% (unchanged). Other: FAS/CAS operating adjustment ~$30M (prior ~$40M; 2023 actual $110M); non-service FAS pension income ~$310M (prior ~$260M; 2023 $310M); net interest expense ~$650M (2023 $543M); effective tax rate on non-GAAP income 13.0% - 13.5% (2023 13.0%); average diluted shares flat - up slightly (2023 190.6M); capital expenditures ~2% of sales. LHX NeXt: implementation costs totaling $400M expected through 2025; gross run-rate savings of $1B exiting year 3.
ngaap.notes: Adjusted segment operating income/margin = operating income excluding the FAS/CAS operating adjustment, unallocated corporate department expense and the significant / non-recurring items (amortization of acquisition-related intangibles and inventory step-up, merger / acquisition / divestiture-related expenses, divestiture losses and impairments, LHX NeXt implementation costs); in 2024 it equals the sum of segment operating income except where a segment-level impairment is added back (Q4-24 / FY24: $24M at CS). Non-GAAP EPS (2024 basis) = diluted EPS + amortization of acquisition-related intangibles (and inventory step-up) + merger, acquisition and divestiture-related expenses + business divestiture-related losses / impairment of goodwill and other assets + LHX NeXt implementation costs, less income taxes on the adjustments (and NCI portion). Effective tax rate on non-GAAP income = (income taxes + tax on the same items) / (income before income taxes + the items). Adjusted free cash flow = net cash from operating activities - additions to PP&E (net of proceeds from sale of PP&E where shown) + cash used for merger, acquisition and severance (severance included from 2024; prior-year comparatives reclassified). Organic revenue excludes completed divestitures and first-year acquisition revenue (Aerojet Rocketdyne until 28-Jul-2024). Q1-24 LHX NeXt implementation costs $127M = workforce optimization $64M + IT / consulting / other $63M. Non-GAAP tax-rate table tax effects: M&A/divestiture 9, LHX NeXt 12, amortization 62 (= 83).
